native_test_scope: Boundary fixture creates an isolated fully connected set, with subjects dormant/non-solid except when applying native lethal damage; it is not a combat-performance test.
The live run starts all 6001 attackers and 600 defenders with all authored machinery. Only the player is invulnerable; no enemies are culled, made dormant or simplified.
Same native turn/forward/attack command sequence as the prior freeze benchmark; vid_lowerinbackground=false. UI/window progress was monitored throughout.
Live group audit samples every 175 tics; rank snapshot checks defer only while CommandDirty marks a death awaiting its next normal refresh.
The previous uncapped-layout save retains all roster references and 36 saved relief identities, is saved with capped groups, and passes a second reload. A fresh capped save also passes.
The runner stops only its spawned engine instance at the 300-second host limit. The longer scheduled quit sequence was not reached.

timing.rendering: RenderOverlay heartbeat is retained in the raw log; it is not a hardware FPS measurement.
